text:
Arin held his father's warning letter close as rain swept across the abandoned castle.

M.

Elara noticed a scraping sound beyond the sealed northern gate.

“We must not open the northern gate.” Arin warned.

Elara raised her lantern to guide Arin.

...

“Then we follow the wall and look for another entrance.” Elara replied.

Arin followed the outer wall while keeping the warning letter safe.
